sessions.intent: Merge the scattered next-work lists into one, cut event-action from runtime2 and plan it from snapshot's decisions and the code.

actions.context: One list replaces two; done items dropped, the old files point to the new one.
Read the event system whole; found the write-up stale against snapshot 245, 248, 251, 271 and the patch no longer applying.
Five stages; Level's new name is Ingi's; stage 2's navigation shape comes from the coder.

Decisions 3–18 with Ingi: events (not bindings) live on the actor that bound them; each goal, step and action makes its lists on its first run; one question, item.Is(type); clauses in the list at fixed places; on holds its moments; system events load from /system/event by default; a call finds its goal in the app its caller belongs to (reverses snapshot 265).
